digest.component_or_area: Jira reconcile bridge outbound comment sync
propositions: The PRIMARY comment-id dedup skip (comment_ids) was inert, causing duplicate bot comments to be re-posted on every hourly reconcile pass across 30 issues totaling 31,683 comments.
REB-1861 reached Jira's 5000-comment hard cap due to accumulated duplicates; comment sync is blocked until duplicates are purged.
29,931 duplicate bot-authored comments were deleted (keep-oldest-per-distinct-normalized-body rule) across 27 issues; REB-1861 reduced from 5000 to 79 comments.

836 comments across three issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) carry no marker due to outbound truncation at 32767 chars removing the trailing marker paragraph; these are phase-2 candidates and were deliberately not executed.
Pre-deletion backups (150MB) and post-deletion verification confirmed zero missing distinct bodies and unchanged non-candidate counts across all 27 affected issues.
The reconcile-bridge workflow remains paused and was not re-enabled by this cleanup operation.
